}

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='rehearsal-', dir=root / 'output') as td:

    profile = base / 'profile'; profile.mkdir()
    prompt = base / 'prompt.txt'
    prompt.write_text('Review literal shell text: "'$(touch SHOULD_NOT_EXIST); `id`; ; echo nope'"\\n', encoding='utf-8')
    for scenario, wanted in expected.items():
        case = base / scenario; case.mkdir()

        evidence = case / 'evidence'

        command = [str(adapter), '--mode', 'explicit', '--prompt-file', str(prompt), '--output-dir', str(evidence), '--grok-home', str(profile), '--grok-bin', str(fake), '--timeout', timeout, '--max-turns', '2']
        started = time.monotonic()
        done = subprocess.run(command, text=True, capture_output=True, env={**os.environ, 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'})

        assert (done.returncode == 0) == (wanted == 'ok')
        assert not (root / 'SHOULD_NOT_EXIST').exists()
        assert len(list(evidence.glob('*/evidence.json'))) == 1
        if scenario in {'direct','envelope','streaming'}:
            payload = json.loads(lines[0]); assert payload['review']['verdict'] == 'PROCEED WITH CHANGES'
            invocation = json.loads((case / 'invocation.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
            assert invocation['prompt'].startswith('Review literal shell text: "'$('"')
            assert invocation['cwdFiles'] == ['prompt.txt', 'review-schema.json', 'reviewer.json']
            assert invocation['agent'] and '\"tools\": []' in invocation['agent']
        if scenario == 'timeout':
            assert elapsed < 3, elapsed
            pid = int((case / 'child.pid').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
            try:
                os.kill(pid, 0)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass
            else:
                raise AssertionError(f'child still alive: {pid}')
        rows.append(f'{scenario}={status}')
    missing = subprocess.run([str(adapter), '--mode','explicit','--prompt-file',str(prompt),'--output-dir',str(base/'missing-evidence'),'--grok-home',str(profile),'--grok-bin',str(base/'absent'),'--timeout','2','--max-turns','2'], text=True, capture_output=True)

    automatic = subprocess.run([str(adapter), '--mode','automatic','--prompt-file',str(prompt),'--output-dir',str(base/'auto-evidence'),'--grok-home',str(profile),'--grok-bin',str(auto_fake),'--timeout','2','--max-turns','2'], text=True, capture_output=True)
